output.reason: The brief is convincing because the evidence fits together: the CR-118 change made just before go-live, a full recalculation in which every shortfall equals the premium for the 20:00–22:00 hours, correct pay for staff on 22:00–06:00 shifts, and a test re-run that matches all 158 night workers. It also gives clear actions for each proposal, though I have to take the audit-trail and recalculation claims on trust because I haven't seen that evidence.
